name: Ghost Network Watch - behavioral health specialty filter

provenance.source: 108 CMS PY2026 machine-readable index probes, 163 sampled provider files (~146k records), scoping/probes/*.json
caveats: Probe truncated specialty strings to 60 chars (sample_providers.py line 95); several list values are cut mid-word - re-extract untruncated in pipeline
bh_specialty_values capped at 25/file from top-500; top_specialties top-20/file - vocabulary is a SAMPLE, not exhaustive; expect new strings at full crawl
sampled_count = occurrences within sampled/truncated file portions, not population counts
20 additional BH-relevant values found in top_specialties that the probe regex MISSED (flagged missed_by_probe_regex)
known_regex_false_negative_classes: credential abbreviations: LMHC, LCMHC, 'Lic. Indpen. Clin. SW', PsyD, 'EdD)'

condition/issue tags: Anxiety Issues/Disorders, Depression Issues, Depressive Disorders, Grief/Loss, Grief and Bereavement, Eap, Attention Deficit Disorders (ADHD), Child Adolescent Issues, Gender Sexuality Issues, Eating Disorders Inpatient Hospital, Abuse, Autism
false-positive class: 'mental' substring matches inside 'developMENTAL' (Developmental Disabilities, Developmental Pediatrics, Developmental Therapist)

steps: 2. Unicode NFKC; normalize apostrophes/quotes (observed bad title-casing: "Master'S Level Counselor")
3. collapse whitespace (observed double spaces: 'Behavioral Health  and  Social Service Providers', 'LICENSED CLINICAL  (LCSW)..')

5. SPLIT multi-value strings on '|' and ';' BEFORE matching (observed: 'Psychologist|Psychology', 'Pediatrics;Psych/Mental Health', 'Case Manager/Care Coordinator|Licensed Clinical Social Worker', 'CRN Practitioner Mental Health|Nurse Practitioner - Psychiat')
7. exact-match against include/exclude lists first; regex tiers only for unseen strings

8. regex fix for v1: replace bare 'mental' with '(?<!develop)mental' and add missing tokens: lmhc, lcmhc, licsw, lmsw, lgsw, counslr, psyd, anxiety, depress, grief, bereave, eap\b, adhd, attention deficit, eating disorder, autism
payer_artifacts_observed: comma-split values: 'Psychologist (PhD' / 'PsyD' / 'EdD)' appear as 3 separate array elements (WellSense NH) - rejoin heuristic or match fragments
NUCC display names as vocabulary (Centene 'Counselor: Mental Health', Elevance 'Addiction (Substance Use Disorder), Counselor', Moda 'Genetic Counselor, MS') - these map 1:1 to taxonomy codes
full NUCC paths: 'Allopathic & Osteopathic Physicians/Psychiatry & Neurology/...', 'Behavioral Health & Social Service Providers : Counselor : ...'
junk fragments in some files: 'Spec.', 'LICENSED', 'OR', 'PD', 'PE', 'OS' (likely upstream split bugs - integrity findings themselves)
normalization.nppes_crosscheck_strategy: NPI is 100% present and Luhn-valid across all sampled files. String filter is only a candidate screen; authoritative BH classification = NPI join to NPPES (weekly Full Replacement Monthly NPI File or NPPES API) taxonomy codes. Score BOTH: (a) BH per payer string but no BH NUCC code in NPPES => 'specialty disagrees with public record'; (b) BH per NPPES but absent/mislabeled in directory => potential ghost/undercount.

nucc_taxonomy_crosscheck.source: nucc_taxonomy_261.csv (v26.1, current), downloaded 2026-08-21 from nucc.org/images/stories/CSV/nucc_taxonomy_261.csv; 883 active codes

critical_gotchas: 2084 prefix ALONE over-captures: 13 of 23 codes in the 2084 family are neurology/other (Neurology 2084N0400X, Sleep 2084S0012X, Sports 2084S0010X, Pain 2084P2900X, Epilepsy, Vascular, Neurocritical, Neuromuscular, Brain Injury, Obesity, Hospice, Clinical Neurophysiology, Diagnostic Neuroimaging). Enumerate the 8 psychiatry subcodes explicitly.
Verified against CSV: 2084S0010X = SPORTS Medicine, 2084S0012X = SLEEP Medicine (easy to flip)

Grouping-level '10' prefix is NOT a code prefix: BH & Social Service grouping codes start 101/102/103/104/106 but 1041 (Social Worker) vs 104100000X - match on the listed classification prefixes, not '10'
Genetic Counselor 170300000X is in 'Other Service Providers' grouping - the display name 'Genetic Counselor, MS' explains bare-'Counselor' collisions
PA psychiatry has NO dedicated NUCC code (only 363A Medical/Surgical) - psych-PA strings cannot be NPPES-verified at specialization level
225XM0800X (Occupational Therapist, Mental Health) is a BH-flavored code inside the excluded OT family

ambiguous.rule: 'Medication Management' (80x, Cigna BH file), 'Autism' (10x, GHC-SCW), 'Abuse' (40x, Providence OR) are condition/service tags whose meaning depends on file vocabulary. In observed files all sit in BH-tag vocabularies (siblings: Anxiety Disorders, Depressive Disorders, Grief and Bereavement, ECT Inpatient). Rule: include only when file-level vocabulary is detected as BH-condition-tag style; resolve provider via NPPES.

Bare 'Counselor'/'Counseling' is BH (NUCC 101Y00000X) in NUCC-display-name-derived vocabularies: in every observed file carrying it (Christus, Centene, Moda-AK, Antidote, Intermountain, Mending, Sendero, Elevance), genetic counselors appear as a SEPARATE value ('Genetic Counselor, MS' = NUCC display name for 170300000X). Rule: include when the same file also carries a distinct genetic-counselor value or other NUCC display names; always resolve via NPI->NPPES taxonomy.
